drunk tank.gloss: (slang) A cell where people who have been arrested for public drunkenness are detained until they are sober.

drupe.gloss: (botany) a kind of fruit, with a fleshy exterior, formed from the exocarp and mesocarp, surrounding a hardened endocarp which protects the seed.

dry.gloss: (chemistry) Anhydrous: free from or lacking water in any state, regardless of the presence of other liquids.
(transitive, figurative) To exhaust; to cause to run dry.

dry ice.gloss: Carbon dioxide frozen in the solid state, used especially as a cooling agent and for the production of fog-like special effects. It sublimes at −78.5 °C (−109.3 °F) at normal atmospheric pressure.

dry out.gloss: (intransitive) To have excess water evaporate or be otherwise removed; to become dry.

dry rot.gloss: (plant disease) A fungal infection which affects plants, in particular potatoes.

dry season.gloss: Any season in which little rain falls; used especially in the tropics where it alternates with the rainy season.

dryer.gloss: (most often) Short for clothes dryer, tumble dryer

dual.gloss: Characterized by having two (usually equivalent) components.
(mathematics) Of a vector in an inner product space, the linear functional corresponding to taking the inner product with that vector. The set of all duals is a vector space called the dual space.

dualism.gloss: (theology) The belief that the world is ruled by a pair of antagonistic forces, such as good and evil; the belief that man has two basic natures, the physical and the spiritual.

duality.gloss: (projective geometry) The interchangeability of points and planes.

dubai.gloss: A city in the United Arab Emirates; the capital of Dubai emirate.

dubbing.gloss: (film) The replacement of a voice part in a film or animation, particularly with a translation, revoicing.

dubitation.gloss: (uncountable, archaic) The process of doubting or the state of being in doubt; hesitation, uncertainty.
(countable) A pang or expression of doubt.

dublin.gloss: (metonym) The government of the Republic of Ireland.

dubnium.gloss: A transuranic chemical element (symbol Db) with atomic number 105.

dubstep.gloss: A subgenre of electronic dance music descended from 2-step garage that was popular in the early 2010s, characterized by its dark mood, sparse half-step and two-step rhythms, and emphasis on sub-bass.

ducat.gloss: (historical) A gold coin minted by various European nations.

duchy.gloss: A dominion or region ruled by a duke or duchess.

duck.gloss: An aquatic bird of the family Anatidae, having a flat bill and webbed feet.
(uncountable) The flesh of a duck used as food.

duckburg.gloss: A fictional city, located in the fictional US state of Calisota, that serves as the home of Donald Duck, his surrounding cast, and several other anthropomorphic animals.

ducktail.gloss: A hairstyle in which the hair is swept back into an upturned point at the back.

duckweed.gloss: Any of several reduced floating aquatic plants in the subfamily Lemnoideae of the family Araceae.

duct.gloss: A pipe, tube or canal which carries gas or liquid from one place to another

dud.gloss: (informal) A device or machine that is useless because it does not work properly or has failed to work, such as a bomb, or explosive projectile.

dude.gloss: (slang) A term of address, usually for a man, conveying awe, excitement, surprise, annoyance, etc.
(chiefly, US, Canada, colloquial) A man, generally a younger man.

due.gloss: On a direct bearing, especially for the four points of the compass.

due date.gloss: The date on which a pregnant female is expected to give birth, which is determined by the term for the species.

due to.gloss: Caused by; resulting from; because of.

duel.gloss: Arranged, regular combat between two private persons, often over a matter of honor.

duffel bag.gloss: (US, AU, often, _, military) A large, cylindrical, duffel cloth bag used to carry personal gear, especially by soldiers.

dugong.gloss: A plant-eating aquatic marine mammal, of the species Dugong dugon, found in tropical regions.

duke.gloss: The male ruler of a duchy (female equivalent: duchess).

dulcimer.gloss: A stringed instrument, with strings stretched across a sounding board, usually trapezoidal, played by plucking on the strings (traditionally with a quill) or by tapping on them (in the case of the hammer dulcimers).

dull.gloss: Lacking the ability to cut easily; not sharp.

duma.gloss: A Russian legislative assembly such as the historical duma of the Russian Empire or the modern lower house of the Federal Assembly (the Russian national parliament).

dumb.gloss: (informal, pejorative, especially of a person) Stupid.

dumbass.gloss: (US, sometimes considered, _, vulgar, slang, mildly, derogatory) A stupid or foolish person. [1959]

dumbbell.gloss: A weight training implement consisting of a short bar with weight counterpoised on each end.

dumbfuck.gloss: (vulgar, slang, derogatory) An extraordinarily stupid person.

dumbstruck.gloss: So shocked as to be unable to speak.

dummkopf.gloss: A stupid person; a dolt, dimwit, or blockhead.

dummy.gloss: A figure of a person or animal used by a ventriloquist; a puppet.
A person who is the mere tool of another; a man of straw.

dumpling.gloss: (chiefly, US) Specifically, a food composed of a dough wrapper around a filling.

dumpster.gloss: (Canada, US) A large, usually metal trash receptacle designed to be hoisted up by a garbage truck in order to be emptied.

dune.gloss: (geomorphology) A ridge or hill of sand piled up by currents of wind or water.

dungan.gloss: A Muslim people originally from north-west China who currently reside in Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Russia.

dungarees.gloss: Heavy denim pants or trousers, usually with bib and braces, worn especially as work clothing.

dungeon.gloss: An underground prison or vault, typically built underneath a castle.

dunkirk.gloss: A town in Nord department, Hauts-de-France, France.

dunnock.gloss: A small European and Asian passerine bird, Prunella modularis; the hedge sparrow or hedge warbler.

duodenum.gloss: (anatomy) The first part of the small intestine, starting at the lower end of the stomach and extending to the jejunum.

duopoly.gloss: (economics) An economic condition in which two sellers exert most control over the market of a commodity.
duopoly.value: 雙頭壟断 双头垄断

duplex.gloss: (US, Canada, Australia) A house made up of two dwelling units.
(philately) A cancellation combining a numerical cancellation with a second mark showing time, date, and place of posting.

duplicate.gloss: One that resembles or corresponds to another; an identical copy.
(transitive) To do repeatedly; to do again.

durability.gloss: The ability to last a long time by virtue of the power to resist stress or force.

durable.gloss: Able to resist wear or decay; lasting; enduring.

duralumin.gloss: (metallurgy) An alloy of over 90% aluminium, 4% copper and traces of manganese, magnesium, iron and silicon, widely used in the aircraft industry.

duration.gloss: An amount of time or a particular time interval.

durian.gloss: The spiky edible fruit of this tree, known for its strong taste and very strong, unpleasant odor.

during.gloss: For all of a given time interval; throughout; in; pending.

durum wheat.gloss: Triticum turgidum subsp. durum, syn. Triticum durum (hard wheat), the flour of which is used to make pasta and bread.

dusk.gloss: The time after the sun has set but when the sky is still lit by sunlight; the evening twilight period.

dust.gloss: (countable, obsolete) A single fine, dry particle of earth or other material; grain of dust.

dust bunny.gloss: (US, informal) A small clump of dust, fluff, hair, particles of skin, etc., that tends to accumulate indoors in areas not regularly dusted, such as under heavy furniture.

dust devil.gloss: A small atmospheric vortex appearing in clear, dry conditions, made visible by swirling dust (or dirt or sand) picked up from the ground.

dust jacket.gloss: (printing, publishing) The detachable paper cover of a book; used to protect the binding, and to provide a blurb.

dust mask.gloss: A protective mask which covers the mouth and nose of the wearer, worn when in a dusty atmosphere, or when doing work which creates dust.

dust up.gloss: (transitive, slang) To attack (a person) physically; to beat up.

duster.gloss: An object, such as a cloth or a purpose-made soft and puffy pad or mitt, used for dusting surfaces etc.

dustpan.gloss: A flat scoop with a handle, into which dust, dirt and other material is conveyed with a brush or broom.

dustup.gloss: (informal, by extension) An argument or dispute.

dutch.gloss: Of or pertaining to the Netherlands, the Dutch people or the Dutch language.
The main language of the Netherlands, Flanders (i.e., the northern half of Belgium) and Suriname; Netherlandic.

dutch guiana.gloss: (historical) A former Dutch colony in northern South America, existing from 1621 to 1959, mostly in the area of modern Suriname.

dutchman.gloss: A Dutch man; a man from the Netherlands.

dutchwoman.gloss: A Dutch woman; a woman from the Netherlands.

duty.gloss: (countable, uncountable) That which one is morally or legally obligated to do.
(countable) A tax placed on imports or exports; a tariff.

(engineering) The efficiency of an engine in work done per unit of fuel; particularly, the number of pounds of water which a steam pumping engine can raise one foot by burning one bushel or hundredweight of coal.

duvet.gloss: (British, Ireland, New Zealand, Canada) A quilt or usually flat cloth bag with a filling (traditionally down) and usually an additional washable cover, used instead of blankets; often called a comforter or quilt, especially in US English.

dvd.gloss: (countable) Initialism of digital video/versatile disc; an optical disc on which video is recorded in digital format, such as commercially-released movies and other video media.

dwarf planet.gloss: (astronomy) A planetary (world-like) body of the Solar system, that directly orbits the Sun like the classical planets but does not gravitationally dominate other bodies in the region of its orbit.

dwarfism.gloss: The condition of being a dwarf (person of short stature).

dwell.gloss: (intransitive, now, _, literary) To live; to reside.

dwelling.gloss: A house or place in which a person lives; a habitation, a home.

dwindle.gloss: (intransitive) To decrease, shrink, diminish, reduce in size or intensity.

dyad.gloss: A set of two elements treated as one; a pair.

dye.gloss: A colourant, especially one that has an affinity to the substrate to which it is applied.

dyer.gloss: One who dyes, especially one who dyes cloth etc. as an occupation.

dyestuff.gloss: Any soluble pigment used for dyeing the hair, fabric, etc.

dyke.gloss: An embankment formed by the spoil from the creation of a ditch.

dynamic.gloss: A characteristic or manner of an interaction; a behavior.

dynamics.gloss: (physics) The branch of mechanics that is concerned with the effects of forces on the motion of objects.

dynamite.gloss: A class of explosives made from nitroglycerine in an absorbent medium such as kieselguhr, used in mining and blasting.

dynamo.gloss: (electromagnetism) An electricity generator; a dynamo-electric machine.

dynamometer.gloss: Any of various devices used to measure mechanical power, force, or torque.

dynasty.gloss: A series of rulers or dynasts from one family.

dyne.gloss: A unit of force in the CGS system; the force required to accelerate a mass of one gram by one centimetre per second per second. Symbol: dyn.

dysgraphia.gloss: A language disorder that affects a person's ability to write.

dyslexia.gloss: (neurology, pathology) A learning disability characterized by reading and writing difficulties.

dysmenorrhea.gloss: (medicine) Painful menstruation (menstrual#Adjective pain), viewed as a symptom#Noun in any of various disorders.

dysmorphia.gloss: (psychology, psychiatry) Any of various psychological disorders of distorted body image in which a person inaccurately believes that their body is misshapen or inadequate, such as anorexia, bulimia, and muscle dysmorphia ("bigorexia").

dyspareunia.gloss: (medicine) Painful or difficult sexual intercourse, especially in women.

dysphemism.gloss: (uncountable) The use of a word or phrase carrying negative connotations or imagery (especially one that is derogatory, offensive or vulgar) to replace a (more) neutral original.

dysphoria.gloss: A state of feeling unwell or unhappy; a feeling of emotional and mental discomfort and suffering from restlessness, malaise, depression, or anxiety.

dysplasia.gloss: (pathology) Abnormal development of cells or tissue, often a precancerous stage of growth.

dystopia.gloss: A miserable, dysfunctional state or society that has a very poor standard of living or severe censorship, oppression, etc.

dzongkha.gloss: The national language of Bhutan; Bhutanese.

dzud.gloss: An ecological crisis in the steppe-land of Mongolia and Central Asia causing loss of livestock, typically a summer drought followed by a severe winter.

déjà vu.gloss: Loosely or humorously, anything one has done before or is being repeated.

département.gloss: An administrative unit in various French-speaking countries, smaller than a région, similar to an English county.

düsseldorf.gloss: The capital city of North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany.
